title: Krazzy 4
desc: A doctor takes four intellectually disabled patients to a cricket match but gets kidnapped. The four team up with a TV channel girl to find and rescue her.

title: Saagar
desc: Raja secretly loves Mona, but she loves Ravi. Ravi's grandmother disapproves, forcing Mona to choose between love and family, leaving Raja heartbroken yet hopeful.

title: Satyaprem Ki Katha
desc: Sattu, a failed lawyer, dreams of marrying Katha, a girl out of his league. Fate unites them, and Sattu tries to win her love with sincerity.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
desc: Kabir, Imran, and Arjun set off on a vacation in Spain before Kabir's wedding, where the journey helps them mend bonds, heal old wounds, embrace life, and face their deepest fears.

title: Veere Di Wedding
desc: Kalindi's friends Avni, Sakshi, and Meera reunite for her wedding. Sakshi takes them to Thailand, where they rediscover themselves and confront their personal struggles.

title: Singham Again
desc: Drawing parallels to the Ramayana, Bajirao Singham leads his team on a daring mission to rescue his wife while facing a powerful and mysterious enemy.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
desc: Pawan, a devotee of Lord Hanuman, finds a girl, who is speech impaired, lost in Haryana. He soon learns that she belongs to Pakistan and sets out to reunite her with her family at great personal cost.

title: Double Dhamaal
desc: Four idlers dream of wealth by investing in buildings. Kabir cons them, leaving them broke. Determined, they set out to avenge their humiliation and reclaim dignity.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Radhe : Your Most Wanted Bhai
desc: Radhe, a fearless Mumbai Police encounter specialist, takes on a ruthless drug lord. His mission is dangerous, but his determination to end crime drives him through battles and chaos.

title: Kasme Vaade
desc: Raju, guilt-ridden over his brother's death, meets Amit's lookalike, Shankar, and unknowingly becomes entangled in a deeper mystery, making amends while facing unsettling truths.

title: Laadla
desc: Headstrong factory owner Sheetal marries Raju, the union leader, intending to crush his spirit and teach him a lesson, but their clash soon turns into a battle of wills.

title: Baazigar
desc: Ajay Sharma seduces and kills a businessman's daughter, staging it as a suicide. He then plots to destroy the entire family, driven by a cold vendetta.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.

title: Mass Jathara
desc: An honest railway cop is transferred to a small town. He fights to bring down a smuggling network run by a powerful drug lord.

title: Border 2
desc: Tensions between East and West Pakistan cause migrants to cross into India. India supports Bengali independence. Pakistan attacks. Four soldiers trained by Fateh Singh defend land, air, and sea.

title: Turtle
desc: Ramkaran struggles to extract water in a drought-hit village. As thirst grows, villagers search for desperate solutions, revealing the harsh realities of survival and hope.
